source: reference/design/benchmark.md in the 5050cloud repository, from the demo pipeline's make bench
vm: Ubuntu 24.04, 2 vCPU (AMD EPYC), 8 GB RAM, one host. lscpu: 1 core, 2 threads per core.
app: apps/node-cpu: each request counts the primes below LIMIT on Node's main thread
load: oha 1.16.0 on the same VM through the HTTPS proxy, 16 connections, 15 s warm-up, median of 3 runs of 30 s
why: The VM's two vCPUs are two hardware threads of one physical core, and this work keeps that core's divider busy, so a second process mostly waits for the same unit.
